model_annotation: The chart illustrates stacked bar representations of retrieval time, segmented into Search, Extract, and Fetch components. The horizontal axis displays three categories: Avg., 50%, 75%, and 90%, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis, labelled "Avg. sec," exhibits a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 8.0, with tick labels every 2.0 seconds. Each bar represents the total retrieval time for a given category, composed of three colored sections representing the Search (dark blue), Extract (light blue), and Fetch (medium blue) operations. The bar corresponding to "Avg." has a total height of approximately 6.2 seconds, composed of Search (approximately 3.4 seconds), Extract (approximately 1.4 seconds), and Fetch (approximately 1.4 seconds). The 50% bar has a total height of nearly 3.2 seconds, composed of Search (approximately 1.8 seconds), Extract (approximately 0.8 seconds), and Fetch (approximately 0.6 seconds). The 75% bar shows a total height of roughly 4.4 seconds, with Search at approximately 2.5 seconds, Extract at approximately 1.0 seconds, and Fetch at approximately 0.9 seconds. The 90% bar has the greatest total height, reaching nearly 8.0 seconds and composed of Search (approximately 4.2 seconds), Extract (approximately 1.7 seconds), and Fetch (approximately 2.1 seconds). No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation and stacked arrangement.
